hero.description1: Nano is the only currency with zero fees, sub-second finality, and no smart-contract complexity — purpose-built for the machine economy where AI agents transact autonomously.
hero.description2: From per-token LLM billing to the x402 payment protocol, Nano gives agents a frictionless value layer that traditional finance and blockchain networks cannot match.

features.title: Why Agents Choose Nano
features.subtitle: Optimized for high-frequency, low-latency, autonomous transactions.

instantSettlement.title: Instant Feeless Settlement
instantSettlement.instantText: Nano settles in under 500ms — agents don't wait for block confirmations. Real-time value transfer for real-time inference, API calls, and autonomous decision-making.
instantSettlement.feelessText: Send $0.000001 economically. Every micro-payment is viable — perfect for per-token LLM billing, streaming compute costs, and pay-per-tool usage.
instantSettlement.decentralizedText: No central authority can freeze funds or censor transactions. Agents operate with full financial autonomy, guaranteed by decentralized consensus.

agentNative.title: Agent Native
agentNative.description: Simple light-weight RPCs. No complex smart contracts to audit, no gas to estimate, no nonces to manage.

x402Protocol.title: x402 Protocol
x402Protocol.description: The HTTP standard for payment-required resources. Agents can autonomously pay/charge for any API, data feed, or tool access.

sustainableCompute.title: Sustainable Compute
sustainableCompute.description: AI training is energy intensive — payments shouldn't be. Nano consumes negligible energy per transaction and adds zero carbon footprint to your stack.

mcpIntegration.title: MCP Integration
mcpIntegration.description: Provides direct access to Nano RPCs. AI agents can query balances, send transactions, and monitor the network programmatically.

x402.title: x402 in Action
x402.subtitle: How AI agents pay for resources in real time using the HTTP 402 protocol and Nano.

apiPaymentFlow.title: Per call API Payment Flow
apiPaymentFlow.description: APIs respond with HTTP 402 and payment details. The agent pays with Nano, attaches the proof, and gets instant access — no API keys or subscriptions needed.

llmBilling.title: Per-Prompt LLM Billing
llmBilling.description: Pay per inference call instead of monthly subscriptions. Agents only spend on what they use — each prompt is a single instantly confirmed feeless transaction.

workflow.title: Workflow Automation
workflow.subtitle: Integrate Nano into n8n workflows, automate feeless payment workflows.

howItWorks.title: How Nano Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A unique architecture designed for instant, feeless value transfer.

step1.title: Your Own Blockchain
step1.description: Every account has its own blockchain (account-chain). No shared state, no contention, no bottlenecks — unlimited throughput by design.

step2.title: Asynchronous Transfers
step2.description: Transactions split into independent send and receive blocks. Both parties act on their own chain — no waiting for the other side.

step3.title: Instant Consensus
step3.description: Open Representative Voting (ORV) confirms transactions in under 1 second. No mining, no staking — just lightweight voting with minimal energy.

q1.question: Is Nano really feeless?
q1.answer: Yes. There are no transaction fees of any kind. Nano uses a lightweight, client-side proof of work to rate-limit spam — but this costs the sender nothing. Every raw unit you send is exactly what the recipient receives.

q2.question: How fast is Nano?
q2.answer: Typical transactions confirm in under 1 second. Nano's block-lattice architecture and Open Representative Voting (ORV) consensus eliminate the need for mining or block intervals, allowing near-instant finality.

q3.question: What is x402?
q3.answer: x402 is a protocol built on the HTTP 402 "Payment Required" status code. When an AI agent requests a paid resource, the server responds with payment details. The agent sends Nano, retries the request with proof of payment, and receives the resource — all without human intervention.

q4.question: Is Nano decentralized?
q4.answer: Yes. Nano uses Open Representative Voting (ORV) where account holders delegate voting weight to representatives of their choice. Anyone can run a representative node, and no single entity controls the network. Voting weight is distributed across hundreds of independent representatives.

q5.question: How do I start building with Nano?
q5.answer: Visit <link>docs.nano.org</link> for the protocol specification and RPC reference. You can run your own Nano node, use public RPC endpoints, or integrate via Nano MCP servers for AI agent workflows. Client libraries are available for Python, JavaScript, Rust, and more.
